verdict.rationale: Bento is an AI-agent observability and improvement platform with its own agentic features, such as signals trained from plain English and auto-generated fixes. A buyer could reasonably ask whether it accepts external MCP servers as tools, so the axis applies. The only MCP mention is coding agents loading Bento's docs over MCP, which is Bento serving content, not consuming tools. Nothing shows users can plug MCP servers into Bento for it to use.
